title: Voice - container owning 2 RandomWalks + PitchShifter + DelayLineFrac + AllpassChain + TiltFilter + constant-power pan, per-sample process with interpolated walk values
description:
Implement Source/DSP/Voice.h and Source/DSP/Voice.cpp — one virtual double-track performer per ShredDouble_Build_Spec.md §4.2, §4.3–4.6.

Before editing, inspect:
- Source/DSP/RandomWalk.h, AllpassChain.h, TiltFilter.h (b.1–b.3 APIs)
- Source/DSP/PitchShifter.h (setDetuneCents, processSample, setLatencyMode, prepare)
- Source/DSP/DelayLineFrac.h (setDelayMs, processSample, prepare)
- .abracapocus/ShredDouble_Build_Spec.md §4.2 voice composition, §4.4 shifter drive, §4.6 pan law + wet accumulation, §4.9 latency modes, §8 buffer sizing

Implement class Voice:
1. Owns: RandomWalk delayWalk + pitchWalk; PitchShifter shifter; DelayLineFrac delay; AllpassChain diffusion; TiltFilter tilt; float nominalDelayMs, panL, panR (constant-power pan from panPercent in [-100,100]); voiceIndex.
2. prepare(sampleRate, maxBlockSize): prepare all children; size DelayLineFrac for >=35 ms + guard via its prepare; PitchShifter studio max; set AllpassChain/TiltFilter voice index; reseed both walks from masterSeed + voiceIndex + distinct axis tags; reset walks to mean.
3. setPanPercent(p): panL/panR via constant-power (e.g. cos/sin of mapped angle).
4. setParams block-rate: timingSpreadMs, pitchSpreadCents, humanRate/tightness forwarded to walks; setLatencyMode to shifter; optional muteGain for V=2 unused voices.
5. reseed(masterSeed) reseeds both axis streams and reset().
6. Per-sample processSample(float x) noexcept chain:
   - advance/interpolated delayWalk → tau_ms; pitchWalk → deltaC
   - shifter.setDetuneCents(deltaC) (or equivalent per-sample path if already smoothed inside shifter) then y = shifter.processSample(x)
   - delay.setDelayMs(tau_ms); y = delay.processSample(y)
   - y = diffusion.processSample(y); y = tilt.processSample(y)
   - outL += y * panL * mute; outR += y * panR * mute (either accumulate into caller refs or return mono and let caller pan — prefer processSample(x, &accL, &accR) matching §4.6)
7. Getters for current tau_ms and deltaC for DriftDisplay/tests. No allocation outside prepare. Do not wire MonoSafetyCrossover/Width/mix (engine owns those later).

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY allowed_write_paths. Do not edit RandomWalk/AllpassChain/TiltFilter implementations unless a missing public API absolutely blocks Voice — prefer using existing APIs; if a tiny public getter is missing, note it but do not expand scope (b.1–b.3 own those files).
acceptance_criteria: Voice owns delayWalk pitchWalk PitchShifter DelayLineFrac AllpassChain TiltFilter plus nominalDelayMs and panL/panR
prepare prepares all child DSP objects and allocates nothing in processSample
Per-sample path feeds interpolated walk delay into DelayLineFrac and interpolated deltaC into PitchShifter then AllpassChain and TiltFilter
Constant-power pan law applied when accumulating into wet L/R
reseed(masterSeed) deterministically reseeds both RandomWalk axes using voiceIndex and axis tags
Voice includes headers from RandomWalk AllpassChain TiltFilter PitchShifter DelayLineFrac only as dependencies (does not redefine them)
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: modify Source/DSP/RandomWalk.* Source/DSP/AllpassChain.* Source/DSP/TiltFilter.* bodies (owned by b.1–b.3)
implement ShredDoubleEngine mono-safety width mix in this task

allowed: constant-power pan via half-pi mapping of pan percent
forward child prepare/reset without wrapping juce::dsp::ProcessorChain
forbidden: own MonoSafetyCrossover or WidthProcessor inside Voice
